text: ぼくの　まね　して　そんなに　たのしい　かい？

structure.jp: ぼくの　まね　して
そんなに　たのしい　かい？

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to what comes next. Here it gives the thing that is being judged as fun. まね　して　たのしい = 'copying is fun'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい at the end is a soft, friendly way to ask a yes-or-no question, used mostly by men. たのしい　かい = 'is it fun?'.
